Their handles are only used to write the tags into your caption when you post. Nothing is sent to them or to anyone else.

In April of 2026, I turned fifty and wanted to mark the year in a meaningful way. So, I took on a challenge: Fifty Acts of Good in Year 50. To hold myself accountable, I logged each act and shared it on social media, hoping others might see a simple gesture of kindness and think, “Oh, I could do that.”

I quickly realized that the acts themselves were only part of the story. They became a catalyst for spending time with the people I love, whether baking for new neighbors, volunteering alongside friends, or tackling projects with family. Along the way, I kept a journal filled with ideas, notes, expenses, and memories.

This is the framework of that journal, designed to help you track your own journey and create a record of the good you put into the world. Choose a number that feels right for your life and begin when you’re ready.

What good can you spread?

Savannah, GA

A backup

How to keep one safe

  1. Tap Create backup.
  2. A panel slides up from the bottom with a row of icons. Choose Save to Files — your phone’s own filing cabinet.
  3. Pick iCloud Drive and tap Save. On an Android phone it is Google Drive.

Anywhere that is not only this phone. Once a month is plenty, and again after any act you would hate to lose.
